fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Air-Standard Brayton Cycle + Spool Dynamics ODE
source: Moran & Shapiro (2014), Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics 8th ed., Ch.9; Saravanamuttoo, Rogers & Cohen (2009), Gas Turbine Theory 6th ed., Ch.2-3; cp(T) polynomial fit per NASA Glenn (McBride et al. 2002) / Cengel & Boles (2015) air tables.

unit.name: GE 7F.04-class simple-cycle gas turbine (185 MW ISO) — air-standard physics model

P_rated_MW.note: ISO net shaft/electrical output (reused from EC100 F1b)

eta_rated.note: Net thermal efficiency at ISO (EC100 F1b reference)

pressure_ratio.note: Compressor total pressure ratio (F-class ~17-19); Saravanamuttoo Ch.3

eta_turbine.note: Turbine isentropic efficiency (cooled HP turbine; Saravanamuttoo 2009)

eta_combustor.note: Combustion efficiency (fraction of fuel LHV released)

TIT_K.note: Turbine inlet temperature limit (F-class firing temp ~1430 degC); metallurgical limit

mdot_air_kg_s.note: Air mass flow at ISO (F-class ~430 kg/s)

LHV_fuel_MJ_kg.note: Lower heating value of natural gas (EC100 F1b)

regen_effectiveness.note: Recuperator effectiveness (0 = no regeneration; set >0 to enable)

I_spool_kg_m2.note: Lumped rotor/shaft polar moment of inertia (large industrial GT)

N_rated_rpm.note: Rated shaft speed (50/60 Hz synchronous, 2-pole eqv.)
